translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs X Sakizs
Jiszs krlzbzle taon kc etu Jeriko badr ncblo nedeng x sc tzkawipelr.
Mzli lc kzdq kc ncblo kx mnc mz taon lcde, drtqde Sakizs. Nide nardr krkcng tzatakqting takes mz taon lcde, x rngisc.
X Sakizs lc, tqabzle nzrmcngr Jiszs, a' trpnzngr murde zbo ngr leplz kc, x nide ncblo kx mrbcnelzbz.
Zbz sc tqvope kai, tqrlaszpxpele zbo ngr leplz kc. Sc tqolzpe mz kzdq nc sikomo murde rpile namcomle Jiszs nzvzki-krmle mz lrpzki kc.
Jiszs vzkimle mrkc, obqlzbz x mcle Sakizs. Sc tqrpipebzle bade kx, “Sakizs, voo-anim murde namncx mz ma nyzm mzbq ka.”
Sakizs votxo-anim. X kx nzkrlzbzlr ma nyzde, abrtz-ngrde nzadwatr-krdele.
Leplz kcng tzrmcng da lc drtwrdr lctx, murde mz drtwrdr nzvztr-krbz Jiszs ma nyzde drtwr ngrde kx abrtzlvzle alwx ngr Sakizs. Sc tzrpipelr kx, “Mrlx lc vztrpebz mz ma nyz ncblo lc tqale zvz alwx!”

Mzli kc Jiszs tzmncbe-ngrdr badr, Sakizs kc tqtekqtrpele nqmq nr drtwrde. Tutxlzm, sc tqrpipebzle bade kx, “Kxetu rnge, kzdq se da napibo bam! Dztungeng lcng kqlu nakabo mz krkcng trpnzngr scdr da. X krkcng tqangqngutitrxng, naxpe-mopwc' nzwrde napwx, navz-nqblqle Lou sc Mosis.”
Rpibz Jiszs mz krkcng tzlalztqng kx, “Otxpxpe kx Gct arlapxpele ncblo lc, murde nzrlxngiti-krde apule melrmqde Ebraam.
Ninge Mrlx Leplz vz-ngrmc mz nrlc mz nzrtangr-krnge x nzarlapx-krnge doa kxnzmrbrng.”
Kxnzawz-nrbalqng Kx Nzatutr-angidrlr Nzwz-krdr

Mzli kcpwz leplz tzlalztq-ngrpwzlr mz da lc, Jiszs sc tqryapwxpe-mopwz badr kzdq nzycmne-ebzpxngr. Pi-ngrbzle da lc murde sc tzesonetrpebzng Jerusalem, x nzpnzkr drtwrdr le, kx mz nzkrlz-krbzle la Jerusalem, sa nayrlqpe Gct nide mz nzngini-krde king rdr, x lr nrlc amrlx namnclzbzng mz Gct.
Zbz rpibz Jiszs kx, “Kzdq ncblo kxetu navz mrkzble rlru, murde king kxetu ngr mrlcde nakabzle bade zmatq ngr nzngini-krde king r mrnyzde. Zbz sa nayzlu-mop mz nzaclve-krdele.

Mzli kc ycpe pipz nzrlasz-krde mrkc, sc tqaveatipele kxnzawz-nrbalq nedeng nzpnu-esz'. X mz ncblo kxesz' kabzle trau nzkqlu-krde kxmule-esz'. X rpibzle badr kx, ‘Mwapx-ngrbzmu trau scnge lc mzli kc navz-ngrne.’ Zbz sc tqvzpe.
A' kzdung lr mrnyzde nzpxpx-ngrdr nide nzngini-krde king. X sc tzatwzlrpe-ngrbzlr kzdung ncblo mz nibrde, mz nzrpi-krbzlr mz king kc etu kx, ‘Trsutiu drtwrgr ncblo lc nzngini-krde king rgr.’
“Kxmule-esz', a' ncblo kc etu sc tqnginipede king rdr. X mzli lc tqyzlupe-ngr-mople badr, sc tqaveatipele kxnzawz kcng tqka-nebade trau kcng. Murde nakrlzle kx tqlvr kx nzatatrpemlr mz trau scdeng.
Krkc ayrnrngr vztrp x rpibzle kx, ‘Kxetu rnge, trau scm kc tqkame bange nzatatr-krmle nzwrde nzpnu-esz'pe.’
Rpibz king kc kx, ‘Mrlztx angidr. Nim kxnzawz kxmrlz! X nayrlqpex nim mz nzaclvengr taon nyznge nzpnu naesz' murde atutr-angidrq nzwz-krm mz da kxtopwz.’
Kxnzawz krali vztrp x rpibzle kx, ‘Kxetu rnge, trau scm kc tqkame bange nzatatr-krmle nzwrde nzlvqnpe.’
Mz krlc rpibzle kx, ‘Na-aclveq taon nyznge nanzlvqn.’
“Kzdq mou kxnzawz vztr-mop x rpibzle kx, ‘Kxetu rnge, trau scm kc tqkame bange dese. Nux mz lrpz sc tqyrlq-kapqpex.
Mwxlrtix nim, murde suti drtwrm kx nike na-ale kxnzawz nemqng nradr naycbz. X atatrpe' trau mz da kx trvzpxpuu mz nzwz-krm. Mwxlrlvzx trau scm murde ma tqamrbrbo.’

Rpibzle bade kx, ‘Nim kxnzawz kxtrka! Trvz-nqblq-pnzwq natq kx kabo. Na-ayrplapxpex nim navz-nqblqle natqm kc tqpiq. Murde krlzq kx ninge ncblo kc tqayrplapx-zlwzle kxnzawz nengeng kcng tzvz-rbrng x suti drtwrnge kx nike na-alelr nradr naycbz. X atatrpc' trau mz da kx trvzpxpuu mz nzwz-krnge.
?A' memule tryrlqtr-ngrpwzmeu trau scnge mz bxng, murde mz nzyzlu-krmc trau kxmwatipxle nayctrpebz?’
“Zbz kxetu kc sc tqrpipebzle mz leplz nedeng kcng tzyrlwrng mrkc kx, ‘Kapxbzmu trau scnge bade x kabzmu mz kxnzawz kc nzatatr-krmle nzwrde nzpnu tqesz'.’
A' nzrpibzlr bade kx, ‘Kxetu rgr, nzatatr-krmle trau nzwrde nzpnu-esz'pe!’
A' rpibzle kx, ‘Napibo bamu, doa kx aclve-angidrle da kx amnqlzbo bade, sa nartxlvzlzbo nikeng kabo bade. A' krkc traclve-angidrleu da kx kabo bade, kxmule-esz' nike scde pipz, sa nakatxpxbo bade.
X mzli kape, enqmi rngeng kcng trsutiu drtwrdr nzngini-krnge king rdr, vzmimamu mrka x nibqtrpa'mu mz mzke'!’”
Sade Kx Nzprlxlvztingr Nabx Nc Paam Mz Lrpzki R Jiszs Mz Nzvztr-krde Jerusalem
Jiszs sc tqrtwayzbz mz ncblo nedeng. X pibzle da lc mzli kc tzkrlzpe-ngrbzlr mztea kcng li Betpeji x Betzni, mrkc mz Newz ngr Nc Olivi. Zbz sc tqatwzlrpe-ngrde ncblo nedeng nzling.
Rpibzle kx, “Vznamu mz mztea lcmonr tzmcpz. Mzli la navztr-ngrbzmu, sa namcamu dq nei dcngki nzatolvangr kx trnzvonekangr. Yokaepxamu x vzmimamu mrka.
Nzmu kx tqrveabz dq kx, ‘?Memule tqyokaepx-ngrnamule?’ rpibzmu bade kx, ‘Suti drtwr Kxetu.’”
Zbz krkcng tzaveang nzvzng, x da amrlx kcng tqpibz Jiszs badr sc tqngi-datipeng
Murde mzli kc tzyokaepx-ngrpwzlr dcngki kc, kxnzrngineng kc tzrpipebzlr kx, “?Nike tqyokaepx-ngrnamu dcngki la?”
Nzrpibzlr kx, “Suti drtwr Kxetu.” X nzrlr-ngrbzlr nzvzmi-krdrle.
X sc tzvzmipebzlr mz Jiszs. X nzprlxobzlr nzkq scdrng mz nibr dcngki kc, x nzawxbuomlr nide elr.
Mzli kc tqvobe-ngrbzle Jerusalem, zbo ngr leplz kcng nzprlxtiolr nzkq scdrng krali mz lrpzki.
Kx nzesotrpebzlr Jerusalem, mrkc tqvzkiope lrpzki kc mz Newz ngr Nc Olivi, zbo ngr leplz nedeng sc tzgzlvzpelr nide. X nzglqpxlr Gct mz natqdr kxetu, murde da kcng tqmatq tzmcpelr.
Nzrpilr kx, “Glqpxkr King Kxnzmcpx kc tqvzm mz drtq Yawe! Twzme nrwx mz mzlir leplz x Gct. Ngrlvzkr nim kc tqmyalz-esz'ngr.”

Kzdung Farzsi kcng tzmncpxmqng mz zbo kc, drtwrdr ngyape murde leplz lcng tzrpilr kx Jiszs nide Kxnzmcpx, a' Farzsi kcng trnzlxngitilru. Sc tzrpipebzlr mz Jiszs kx, “Kxakrlz, pibz mz leplz nemqng kx namnc-lrping.”
Rpibz Jiszs kx, “Napibo bamu, nzmu namnc-lrpilr, e rplz lcng sc tzkabomipelr natq kcpwz. Murde krlzpebzle mzli rde.”
Jiszs Yrnimile Lr Jerusalem
Zbz sc tzesonetrpebzng mz mzteadau Jerusalem. X kx mcpelele, sc tqyrnimipele lr Jiu.

Sc tqrpipele kx, “Agrm lr mrnyznge, trnzrlxngiti-krpwa'muu amwitrpebzle mzpu. X trmcwamuu nike na-aleamu kx narlapx-ngrnamu mz nzayrplapxkr Gct nimu. Mzli ka sa tqbrngzbe, a' trka-ngrde tr-rlxngitiwamuu.
Mzli la nakaputrp bamu kx enqmi rmung natu-ngalelvz-ngrdr mzteadau nyzmu. X nayrkqlvzlzlr drkq nyzmu mz drtc', murde naesolvztitrpzlr nimu mz nrlarmu amrlx. X trpnzngr me narlakipxamu.
X sa naodatilr nimu lr Jerusalem. Na-awxlikiolr drkq nyzmu x ma nyzmu amrlx. Murde trglxwamuu Gct mzli kc tqoklati-ngrmle nimu mz nzarlapx-krde nimu, a' pxtxpx-ngrnamu nide!”
Jiszs Angyale Nzatrkatingr Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe
Mz nibrde, Jiszs vztr Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe Jerusalem x sc tqmaszlrpxpe-ngrde leplz kcng tzamwating animol kx nangi blz.
Tqrpibzle badr kx, “Nzyro mz Nzryrngrkxtr kx rpi Gct kx, ‘Ma nyznge nangi ma ngr nzkrka'kr leplz.’ A' apusr-ngrnamule me nzamwangr da kcng tqangqnguti-lzbq-ngrnamu!”
Zbz Jiszs alvztr Mangr-nzangiongr mz zbq kcng trkqluu tqmnctibele. Kxnzetu rdr pris x krkcng tzalvztrng mz Lou sc Mosis, x kxnzrmailzng sc tzyrlqpelr drtwr ngr nzrnibqngr nide.
A' rblxbz badr, murde leplz amrlx nalalztq-angidrbzng mz natqdeng amrlx. X narpwa'-ngrbzlr mz kxnzrmailz lcng nzatrkati-krdr nide.

footnotes.text: 19:2 Lr Jiu kc-kzng tztrkalrtingr lr Jiu kcng tzatakqting takes, murde nzangqngutitrlr leplz nedrng x nzwztrpzlr mz gzpman ngr Rom. X krkcng tzatakqting takes nakapxlr trau kx nangi takes namyaszlzle kx pi gzpman. X nzyrlqtxpxlr krkc tqyctrpz nangi scdr. 19:7 Mz nzmnc-lxblrkr Jiszs mz ncblo lc tqtrka, drtwr Jiszs tresz'tiu badr mz alwx ngrdeng, a' rpile na-aelwapx-ngrbzle nivz lr Gct bade.
Be lc aelwapx-ngrde kx Jiszs navztx kai, x mz nibrde nayzlu-mop mz nzngini-krde king r nrlc, mz nzayzlu-krbzle da mz leplz mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nqmq krdr.
Krlc kxmu nzarmyalz-krdr king. X mz drtwrdr Jiszs votr Jerusalem murde na-aclvele Israel mz nzngini-krde Kxnzmcpx kc tqngi King.
Gct oklatipemle lr Jiu mz nzvz-krm Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Nzodatingr Jerusalem lc ngida mz yiz 70 AD mzli kc ami ngr Rom sc tqodatipele Jerusalem x Mangr-nzangiongr Yawe, x nibqtileng leplz ngrdeng amrlx.
